text.title: Till sales against money banked, by restaurant and day
text.lede: A month on one screen: a row per restaurant, a column per day. Grey days banked what the tills recorded. A tinted day is over or short, in the colour of the side that is higher. Read across a row for a habit, down a column for a bad day.
text.chartSub: Cash deposits and card settlements together, in USD. Tolerance is 5.00 per day. Select a day for its tender breakdown.
